name: Gad
summary: A son of Jacob, born to Leah's maid Zilpah. His descendants became the tribe of Gad, who chose to settle on the east side of the Jordan.

key_moments.title: Born to Zilpah
key_moments.description: Leah gave her maid Zilpah to Jacob, and Zilpah bore him a son. Leah named the boy Gad, saying a troop was coming.

key_moments.title: Blessed by Jacob
key_moments.description: Jacob said of Gad that a troop would overcome him, but in the end he would overcome.
